title: In Merry Measure
description: When pop star Darcy returns home to spend Christmas with her sister and niece, she unexpectedly finds herself coaching the high school choir with her onetime rival, Adam.

title: Heart of the Holidays
description: Career-driven Sam returns to her hometown for the holidays, where she comes face-to-face with her high school boyfriend, Noah. Together, they rediscover what matters most in life.

title: A Christmas Cookie Catastrophe
description: Sparks fly between the new CEO of a small-town cookie company and the owner of a local bakery as they try to recreate a stolen secret recipe.

title: Jingle Bell Run
description: Self-described bookworm Avery is paired with retired hockey star Wes to compete in a holiday race across America. The team struggles through themed challenges until romance runs its course.

title: A Bride for Christmas
description: Aiden (Andrew Walker) bets his friends that he can convince a woman to marry him by Christmas, and he sets his sights on Jessie (Arielle Kebbel), a young woman who has sworn off serious relationships.

title: Christmas on My Mind
description: Lucy Lovett wakes up holding a wedding dress and assumes she is about to marry the love her life, Zach Callahan.

title: A Maple Valley Christmas
description: Erica is a rancher who's spent her whole life working the family farm with her mother and sister. When Aaron arrives and disrupts her plans, she starts to question what it is she actually wants.

title: Our Holiday Playbook
description: To help her father win their annual flag football game, Lexi convinces Eddie to join the team as her pretend boyfriend in exchange for coaching him through his family baking contest.

title: Three Wise Men and a Baby
description: Three brothers get the surprise of their lives when they are forced to work together and care for a baby over the holidays.

title: Christmas in Blue Dog Valley
description: Fleeing Hollywood, on-set vet Goldie intends to own the beloved animal clinic in Blue Dog Valley. She strives to earn the town's trust — especially with the help of Cohen, the previous vet's son.

title: Mistletoe and Mimosas
description: After Claire inherits her uncle's Christmas bar following his passing, she competes against its neighboring competitor, and its manager Zach, to help save it from its drowning debt.

title: Christmas Wishes & Mistletoe Kisses
description: Weeks before Christmas, an interior designer is hired to decorate the estate of a wealthy businessman.

title: Time for You to Come Home for Christmas
description: Katherine returns home after her husband passes and meets a veteran who is on his holiday journey. As Christmas nears, they learn of a bond that may be the miracle they need.

title: The Mistletoe Promise
description: Two strangers with a disdain for Christmas make a holiday pact to pretend to be a couple to ease their holiday complications. As they spend more time together, the phony couple begin to experience the magic of Christmas.

title: Christmas Waltz
description: A woman makes an unexpected connection with her dance instructor after her storybook Christmas wedding is canceled.

title: Project Christmas Wish
description: A woman's life becomes transformed as she works toward granting a little girl's wish for a Christmas like she used to have with her mother.

title: 'Tis the Season for Setups
description: When organized caterer Lexi and chill snowboarder Ridge notice a spark between their single parents, they begrudgingly team up to set them up.

title: The Christmas Secret
description: A struggling single mother (Bethany Joy Lenz) searches for a lost family heirloom that she hopes will bring her love and good fortune in time for the holidays.

title: My Christmas Cowboy
description: Years after a college newsroom mishap sent Meg and Billy down opposite life paths, the pair reunite in the small Texas town of Fern where they must team up to save the town's Christmas Roundup.

title: A Royal Queens Christmas
description: A prince makes his way to Queens, N.Y., when a local woman enlists his help for a children's Christmas show.
